inside.title: Run a seat inside Home Assistant
inside.description: Home Assistant downloads the seat of this release from GitHub (its sha256 and every file are checked), keeps its data in the membrane folder of your configuration folder and runs it on this machine. Which model should it think with? Anthropic: Claude with an API key. OpenAI-compatible: any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI chat API (OpenAI, LM Studio, a local server). Ollama: an Ollama server on your network.

anthropic.title: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.description: An API key from the Claude Console (Settings, API keys), scoped to a workspace. The seat calls Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint with it. The key is kept in Home Assistant's configuration and handed to the seat in its environment only.

data.seat_name: Seat name (optional: the seat asks for one otherwise)

openai.title: OpenAI-compatible endpoint
openai.description: The endpoint's root address (the seat adds /v1/chat/completions), the model it is asked for, and its key when it needs one.

data.seat_name: Seat name (optional: the seat asks for one otherwise)

ollama.description: The Ollama server the seat thinks with and a model it has pulled. When Home Assistant has its own Ollama integration, its server and model are filled in.

connect.title: Connect to a seat I run
connect.description: The address of a seat you run (cliffvm) and its admin token. The token is the file admin.token in the seat's data folder, and the seat prints its path when it starts. Or make one on the seat's machine with: cliffvm token mint --ttl 30d --secret-file SEAT-FOLDER/door.secret (SEAT-FOLDER is the data folder that holds door.secret). Every valid token is the admin: Assist, the seat's calls into the house, its sensors and its model select all work with it. See docs/home-assistant.md.

connect_ollama.title: Connect to a seat I run
connect_ollama.description: The address of a seat you run (cliffvm) and its admin token. The token is the file admin.token in the seat's data folder, and the seat prints its path when it starts. Or make one on the seat's machine with: cliffvm token mint --ttl 30d --secret-file SEAT-FOLDER/door.secret (SEAT-FOLDER is the data folder that holds door.secret). Every valid token is the admin: Assist, the seat's calls into the house, its sensors and its model select all work with it. See docs/home-assistant.md. Home Assistant's Ollama integration uses the server {ollama_url} with the model {ollama_model}. To have the seat think with the same server, start it with --fact seat_backend={ollama_url} and pick {ollama_model} in its model select.

reauth_inside.title: Restart the seat
reauth_inside.description: The seat Home Assistant runs refused Home Assistant's token (its key was changed or removed). Submit to restart it: at its start the seat writes a new token, and Home Assistant reads it.

reauth_confirm.title: The seat needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: The seat at {url} refused Home Assistant's token. It ran out, the seat's key changed, or it is a token of the old seat: the old seat's tokens are not valid on the new seat. Paste the new seat's admin token: the file admin.token in the seat's data folder (DATA-FOLDER/admin.token, new at every start of the seat, its path printed at start), or one made with cliffvm token mint --ttl 30d --secret-file DATA-FOLDER/door.secret. With the babyseat add-on, the token is in the add-on's log, and the add-on's discovery hands it to Home Assistant by itself when the add-on starts. More: {docs_url}

reauth_no_seat.title: This entry has no seat
reauth_no_seat.description: This entry ran the seat inside Home Assistant, but its old settings did not say which Ollama server and model it used, so it cannot be started again by itself. Either remove the integration and add it again, choosing Run a seat inside Home Assistant (your chat history is found again), or enter the address and token of a seat that runs elsewhere here. The token is the seat's admin token: the file admin.token in the seat's data folder (its path printed at start), or one made with cliffvm token mint --ttl 30d --secret-file DATA-FOLDER/door.secret. More: {docs_url}

hassio_confirm.title: Connect to the babyseat add-on
hassio_confirm.description: The add-on {addon} runs a seat. Connect Home Assistant to it? Its address and token come from the add-on itself.

hassio_confirm_ollama.title: Connect to the babyseat add-on
hassio_confirm_ollama.description: The add-on {addon} runs a seat. Connect Home Assistant to it? Its address and token come from the add-on itself. Home Assistant's Ollama integration uses the server {ollama_url} with the model {ollama_model}: to have the seat think with the same server, set the add-on's Ollama URL and model options to these. Nothing is set by itself.

error.cannot_connect: The seat didn't answer at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The seat refused the token (wrong, expired, or from another seat).
error.invalid_url: That is not an http:// or https:// address.

abort.already_configured: Membrane is already set up (the add-on's discovery updated its token if it changed).
abort.cannot_connect: The seat didn't answer at the address the add-on gave.
abort.invalid_auth: The seat refused the token the add-on gave.
abort.invalid_discovery: The add-on's announcement had no host, port or token.
abort.already_in_progress: This seat is already being set up.
abort.unsupported_platform: The seat cannot run on this machine: {reason}

send_message.name: Send a message to the seat
send_message.description: Hand the seat a message and do not wait for its answer (the seat answers in its own time, in its chat). The seat session is named by `session`.

session.name: Session
session.description: A name for the conversation; the same name continues the same seat session (default `service`).

ask.name: Ask the seat
ask.description: Ask the seat something and get its answer back as the service's response data (the answer and the session name). Runs a turn of the seat's model, which can take minutes.

session.name: Session
session.description: A name for the conversation; the same name continues the same seat session (default `service`).

seat_stopped.title: The seat inside Home Assistant stopped
seat_stopped.description: The seat Home Assistant runs kept exiting, so it is not restarted any more. Its last words: {reason}. Check the provider's key, model or address (Settings, Devices and services, babyseat, Configure), then reload the integration to start it again.
